land.tagline: Forschungsgetriebener quantitativer Handel. Für Evidenz gebaut. Für Kontrolle entworfen.
land.hero_3d_alt: Animated visualization of the Nexus engine core: a geometric AI core surrounded by market data panels, candlestick structures, risk shield and telemetry — decorative.
land.pipe_desc: From tick to ledger, every stage is isolated behind hexagonal ports. Promotion between stages requires an operator decision on reproducible evidence.
land.d_market: MT5 ticks and bars via ports — the domain never touches the broker.
land.d_features: Strictly causal 50D features (INV-008), NaN/Inf deterministic fallbacks.
land.d_infer: ScalpNet — dual-path TCN + self-attention on artifact manifests.
land.d_policy: ~30 SMC/ICT rules gate every signal into a proposal.
land.d_risk: Kelly sizing, margin ≤20%, HARD_MAX_LOTS, circuit breaker — enforced in the execution path.
land.d_exec: Order state machine, protection ledger, recovery budget, account-identity fail-safe.
land.d_acct: Immutable audit ledger (SQLite WAL) off the tick hot path (INV-001).
land.d_obs: Severity-split logs, incidents, forensic snapshot, read-only notifier (INV-010).
land.d_loop: Research consumes the same contracts: dataset → walk-forward → OOS → replay.
land.why_desc: Not a claim of alpha — a way of treating claims. Evidence grades every capability; candidates never promote themselves.
land.why_evidence_b: Metrics without evidence render n/a. Negative results are published — the 70D candidate was rejected by our own OOS gate.
land.why_causal_b: Strictly causal 50D contract (INV-008) with deterministic fallbacks — identical for live, replay and training, pinned by schema hash.
land.why_det_b: Purged + embargoed walk-forward, bit-exact replay, fingerprinted datasets, models and runs with full provenance.
land.why_risk_b: Hard clamps live in the execution path: Kelly sizing, margin ≤20%, HARD_MAX_LOTS, kill switch — not in a comment.
land.why_truth_b: Broker facts and runtime gates outrank intent and stale caches. Gates are authorities; settings are intent.
land.why_forensic_b: Severity-split logs, incident correlation, deploy gate and the published bug ledger — every failure leaves evidence.
land.modes_desc: The safety model is architectural: PAPER is the default, SHADOW can never place orders, LIVE needs explicit operator confirmation.
land.mode_paper_d: Fully simulated market and orders. For first run, development and UI work — no broker connection at all.
land.mode_shadow_d: Evaluate signals, gates and the full pipeline on real market data — while research, shadow and learning components physically cannot place orders.
land.mode_live_d: Broker IPC / ZMQ with an account-identity fail-safe. LIVE requires explicit operator confirmation and inherits every risk clamp.
land.res_desc: Historical data becomes falsifiable evidence through a fixed chain. Each capability carries an evidence grade — and rejections stay published.
land.res_negative: The 70D candidate (Base+News+Liquidity) is research, not production: the hard OOS gate returned NOT_ELIGIBLE on real-data walk-forward. The live contract stays 50D until a candidate clears every gate and an operator promotes it.
land.market_title: XAUUSD M1 — how Nexus reads the market
land.market_desc: Order Blocks, Fair Value Gaps, liquidity sweeps and the entry-SL-TP envelope are first-class domain concepts enforced by the SMC policy matrix.
land.market_legend: Deterministic demonstration data — illustrative only, never live broker data. Hover or focus the chart to inspect each zone.
land.market_alt: An illustrative XAUUSD candlestick chart showing order block, fair value gap, liquidity sweep, entry, stop loss and take profit zones generated from deterministic demo data.
land.arch_desc: The domain is frozen at the center; everything else — broker, database, web, research — is a swappable adapter behind ports. Click a layer for its documentation.
land.console_desc: A real operator console — live monitoring, strategy research, model governance, news intelligence and the forensic incident center. Screenshot from the shipped Web UI.
land.console_alt: Nexus Control Center screenshot: M1 chart with order block and FVG overlays plus entry, stop loss and take profit lines
land.pulse_desc: Generated at build time from repository truth and refreshed from GitHub's public API — no hard-coded numbers, N/A until proven.
land.cta_title: Bereit, auf Live-Daten zu bewerten — ohne Risiko?
land.cta_desc: Starte im SHADOW. Gleiche Funktionen, gleiche Gates, gleiche Pipeline — null Order-Autorität.

ui.hero_sub: Eine forschungsgetriebene, hexagonale, ereignisgesteuerte Scalping-Plattform für MetaTrader 5 — kausale Features, governete Deep-Learning-Modelle, ein invariantes Risikosystem, deterministische Forschungswerkzeuge und forensische Observability in einer prüfbaren Pipeline.
ui.releases_intro: Jedes Release mit seinen echten Highlights, abgeleitet aus GitHub-Release-Metadaten zur Build-Zeit. Einzelquelle für Versionen:
ui.pillar_evidence_b: Metriken ohne Evidenz zeigen n/a — nie falsche Nullen. Negative Ergebnisse werden veröffentlicht: Unser 70D-Forschungskandidat wurde vom eigenen OOS-Gate abgelehnt.
ui.pillar_safety_b: PAPER als Standard · SHADOW ohne Order-Autorität · LIVE hinter expliziter Bestätigung · harte Risikoklemmen (HARD_MAX_LOTS, Marge ≤20%) im Ausführungspfad erzwungen.
ui.pillar_research_b: Gepurgtes + Embargo-Walk-Forward, bit-exaktes Replay, fingerprintierte Datensätze/Modelle, Provenienz bei jedem Lauf — derselbe Feature-Vertrag für Live, Replay und Training.
ui.pillar_truth_b: Forensische Observability: schweregetrennte Logs, Incident-Korrelation, Deploy-Gate. Broker-Wahrheit schlägt veralteten Zustand; Gates sind Autoritäten, Settings sind Absicht.
